properties.name: HealthCoreMD
properties.description:
HealthCoreMD provides a highly affordable healthcare benefit for employers to offer their workforce as an ancillary benefit or voluntary benefit telehealth programs offer a high return on investment (ROI) for employers who wish to reduce the expenditure of more costly health insurance plans, while improving access to healthcare for their employees. 
Alternatively, employers in the start-up phase of implementing a benefits package may use Virtual Urgent Care initially, then expand with HealthCoreMD's Virtual Therapy Counseling, Medication Discount Plan, Labs, Discount Imaging, Chiropractic and Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) later.
HealthCoreMD subscription-based telehealth programs provide “unlimited” doctor consultations on a fixed monthly rate for employers enrolling their workforce. 
There are no copays, no consultation fees or network access costs, and employers receive discounts based on the number of primary employee members enrolled. Plans may include dependent family members at no extra cost.

With 24/7/365 access to virtual doctor visits, employees are protected from unexpected expenses of doctor copays and urgent care clinic visits. As a member they will receive personalized service and real-human contact from the moment they reach out to our network of U.S. board certified doctors. All doctors and Care Coordinators are U.S. operate in the United States. Only licensed medical doctors conduct consultations, we do not contract with nurse practitioners to handle our consultations. Members access virtual care by phone, mobile app, or video consultations through their HIPAA-compliant “Member/Patient Portal”, fully functional in Spanish and English.

Quality Healthcare, Fast! On average, members receive a call back from the doctor within 8-12 minutes after scheduling a virtual consultation by phone, online or by mobile app. That's less than the drivetime to most urgent care clinics!

My Virtual Physician is a multi-specialty telehealth company serving the United States. The company was conceived in 2019 and formed just before the pandemic in Feb 2020. From the outset the company sought to differentiate itself by focusing on specialist and comprehensive care in contrast with many telehealth companies that were either niche companies focusing on one thing or large companies that were essentially just virtual urgent cares. 

My Virtual Physician provides care across three disciplines: Primary/chronic care; Gynecology; and Endocrinology. My Virtual Physician provides the entire range of consults from simple acute visits to complex visits. My Virtual Physician offers patients in the virtual space the full range of services they would get in a comprehensive multi-specialty clinic in the brick and mortar world. 

If a patient needs a referral we will do all the paperwork. If a patient needs a medical exemption letter for work we will write it. If a patient needs a specialized imaging study, we will coordinate it. If a patient has social needs we will connect them to a community health worker. 

There is arguably no other national telehealth company in the US that provides comprehensive integrated care across multiple specialties the way that My Virtual Physician does. 

My Virtual Physician is blazing a trail in the telehealth world in the US.

What is Really Global?

Really Global is a global telehealth platform and mental health marketplace. We connect clients in more than 200 countries/regions with licensed and non-licensed therapists, psychologists, nurse practitioners, social workers, and other mental health practitioners, as well as non-licensed coaches and mentors through transparent search, instant booking, and "Talk Now" on-demand support. Our platform eliminates traditional barriers by offering direct-pay services without insurance requirements, empowering both providers and clients with complete autonomy over their mental health journey.

Who Does Really Global Serve?

Clients seeking accessible mental health care: People worldwide who struggle to find the right therapist, coach, or mental health professional due to high costs, insurance barriers, geographic limitations, or long wait times. Whether you're looking for specialized trauma therapy that fits your budget, need a career coach available on-demand when work crises hit, or want a mentor who's actually walked your path as a first-generation entrepreneur, you deserve care that fits your life, schedule, and budget.

Mental health professionals seeking practice freedom: Providers who are tired of insurance hassles, exhausted from constant self-marketing, and frustrated with platforms that control their rates and assign their clients. Some are ready to escape the grind entirely and build truly global practices unlimited by geographic borders. Others want to supplement their current full-time work with flexible side income during evenings, weekends, or free hours.

Really Global's Vision Statement is "to connect the world to effective, personalized mental health care."

Really Global's Mission Statement is "to provide clients with the highest quality services, from the most diverse mental health providers, with the utmost convenience."

Really Global's purpose is "to alleviate suffering and foster well-being for everyone."

Twin Health combines advanced medical science and technology with a clinical care team to help people take control of conditions like type 2 diabetes, prediabetes, and obesity. Twin is a metabolic health benefit offered exclusively through employers or health plans. 

Our Digital Twin™ technology learns a member’s unique metabolism based on insights collected from smart devices, meal logs, and lab work. By seeing how their body responds to lifestyle choices, Twin can provide real-time, personalized recommendations on nutrition, activity, sleep, stress, and more. Our clinical care team then guides the member on a clear path toward their health goals, celebrating each win along the way. 

This leads to life-changing results:

💊 73% of members eliminated medications (including injections)
⚡️On average, members lost 14 pounds in 6 months
❤️‍🩹66% of members improved hypertension
💪81% of members improved cholesterol
⚖️On average, members saw a 2.2 point drop in A1C

We also help our partners deliver cost-effective, clinically validated solutions:

- $8.4K annual savings per member with at least one high-cost medication
- $3.2M projected pharmacy savings, annualized across all members with one or more high-cost medications
- Twin is validated by the American Heart Association, American Diabetes Association, The Journal of the American College of Cardiology, and more 

Twin’s outcomes aren’t just clinical and cost-effective — they’re human. Members report feeling more energized, getting a better night’s sleep, and having the energy to play with their kids or grandkids a little longer.

We’re proud to help people feel their best with the power of a healthy metabolism.

- Decreased unnecessary urgent care & ER usage — lowers claims and renewal pressure.

✔ No additional costs for monthly covered visits.

properties.name: Direct Med Clinic
properties.description:
Direct Med Clinic uses the Direct Primary Care (DPC) model to provide a solution to two big problems in health care today: cost and access. A person becomes a member of the clinic by paying a monthly membership fee. Then, anytime they come to the clinic for treatment it is free. The clinic treats all primary care and urgent care needs. By providing direct, transparent, and affordable access to primary care, many people with chronic medical problems that have previously gone untreated can now be taken care of which prevents end-organ damage when chronic conditions are not controlled.

On a large scale, employers who have struggled to provide health care benefits to employees can now do so without high deductibles that limit access. Small employers that have not been able to provide health care benefits to employees due to cost can now do so by directly contracting with Direct Med Clinic.

Our model is duplicatable and sustainable because it inherently provides value. We offer a spectrum of services from primary care to urgent care to occupational medicine. We are not bound by traditional reimbursement systems so, through our virtual care and HIPAA compliant app/tools, we can expand our access way beyond a single brick and mortar clinic which allows us to touch even more lives.

We at Direct Med Clinic are excited to be transforming healthcare, improving the quality of life and healing the bottom line of many companies by restoring the direct doctor-patient relationship with Direct Primary Care.

The views expressed in this social media account are those of the practice, not individual clinicians of the Direct Med Clinic team.

Members access virtual care by phone, mobile app, or video consultations through their HIPAA-compliant “Member/Patient Portal”, fully functional in Spanish and English.

Quality Healthcare, Fast! On average, members receive a call back from the doctor within 8-12 minutes after scheduling a virtual consultation by phone, online or by mobile app. That's less than the drivetime to most urgent care clinics!

entity.name: Really Global
entity.description:
What is Really Global?

Really Global is a global telehealth platform and mental health marketplace. We connect clients in more than 200 countries/regions with licensed and non-licensed therapists, psychologists, nurse practitioners, social workers, and other mental health practitioners, as well as non-licensed coaches and mentors through transparent search, instant booking, and "Talk Now" on-demand support. Our platform eliminates traditional barriers by offering direct-pay services without insurance requirements, empowering both providers and clients with complete autonomy over their mental health journey.

Who Does Really Global Serve?

Clients seeking accessible mental health care: People worldwide who struggle to find the right therapist, coach, or mental health professional due to high costs, insurance barriers, geographic limitations, or long wait times. Whether you're looking for specialized trauma therapy that fits your budget, need a career coach available on-demand when work crises hit, or want a mentor who's actually walked your path as a first-generation entrepreneur, you deserve care that fits your life, schedule, and budget.

Mental health professionals seeking practice freedom: Providers who are tired of insurance hassles, exhausted from constant self-marketing, and frustrated with platforms that control their rates and assign their clients. Some are ready to escape the grind entirely and build truly global practices unlimited by geographic borders. Others want to supplement their current full-time work with flexible side income during evenings, weekends, or free hours.

Really Global's Vision Statement is "to connect the world to effective, personalized mental health care."

Really Global's Mission Statement is "to provide clients with the highest quality services, from the most diverse mental health providers, with the utmost convenience."

Really Global's purpose is "to alleviate suffering and foster well-being for everyone."

Bilingual (Spanish) and multicultural providers. Because everyone deserves care that understands them.

We welcome referrals from any provider—primary care physicians, employee assistance programs, geriatric facilities, and more.

Whatever brings you here, for yourself, your child, or someone you care about, Televero is ready when you are.

Care that moves you forward, from wherever you are.

*Based on responses to Televero patient satisfaction surveys.

entity.name: Twin Health
entity.description:
Twin Health combines advanced medical science and technology with a clinical care team to help people take control of conditions like type 2 diabetes, prediabetes, and obesity. Twin is a metabolic health benefit offered exclusively through employers or health plans. 

Our Digital Twin™ technology learns a member’s unique metabolism based on insights collected from smart devices, meal logs, and lab work. By seeing how their body responds to lifestyle choices, Twin can provide real-time, personalized recommendations on nutrition, activity, sleep, stress, and more. Our clinical care team then guides the member on a clear path toward their health goals, celebrating each win along the way. 

This leads to life-changing results:

💊 73% of members eliminated medications (including injections)
⚡️On average, members lost 14 pounds in 6 months
❤️‍🩹66% of members improved hypertension
💪81% of members improved cholesterol
⚖️On average, members saw a 2.2 point drop in A1C

We also help our partners deliver cost-effective, clinically validated solutions:

- $8.4K annual savings per member with at least one high-cost medication
- $3.2M projected pharmacy savings, annualized across all members with one or more high-cost medications
- Twin is validated by the American Heart Association, American Diabetes Association, The Journal of the American College of Cardiology, and more 

Twin’s outcomes aren’t just clinical and cost-effective — they’re human. Members report feeling more energized, getting a better night’s sleep, and having the energy to play with their kids or grandkids a little longer.

We’re proud to help people feel their best with the power of a healthy metabolism.

By focusing on proactive care rather than reactive treatment, we help employers manage healthcare costs before they impact renewal cycles.

The result is stronger workforce health, higher satisfaction, and a stable, accountable primary care model built to last.

entity.name: easyDoc Health
entity.description:
A subscription-based telehealth medical care solution for Midwest employers who want to offer employees and their families fast, convenient, and affordable access to medical care — without urgent care visits, ER bills, or time away from work. Employees connect directly with a licensed medical provider via secure video or phone.

The healthcare system is breaking under its own weight and employees and employers are paying the price. Every year, families purchase insurance they can't afford to use because of high deductibles and rising health care costs. Employers absorb 6–15% annual premium increases with no improvement in access, outcomes, or satisfaction.

Employer Benefits:
- Decreased unnecessary urgent care & ER usage — lowers claims and renewal pressure.
- Reduced absenteeism — direct, fast access to care reduces wait time to be seen by a clinician. 
- Improved employee satisfaction & retention — modern, high-value benefit.
- No cost to employer unless choosing to subsidize.

How It Works:
✔ Employees subscribe monthly (no cost to employer unless choosing to subsidize). 
✔ Telehealth providers available during business hours or 24/7 (based on plan).
✔ Employees can connect from home, work, or while traveling.
We support urgent needs such as colds, flu, cough, bronchitis; urinary symptoms/infections; allergies, sinus issues; skin issues/rashes; prescription refills; return-to-work guidance.
✔ Lab & imaging orders routed through your existing insurance.

Enrollment:
✔ No additional costs for monthly covered visits.
✔ Subscription costs may be paid using HSA funds.
✔ No core health plan change. We advise to still be part of a health plan, but is not required. 
✔ No contracts, can enroll any time, and billed month to month.
✔ Services may be cancelled any time with a 30 day written notice.

This is healthcare redesigned. Simple, affordable, and effective.

entity.name: Direct Med Clinic
entity.description:
Direct Med Clinic uses the Direct Primary Care (DPC) model to provide a solution to two big problems in health care today: cost and access. A person becomes a member of the clinic by paying a monthly membership fee. Then, anytime they come to the clinic for treatment it is free. The clinic treats all primary care and urgent care needs. By providing direct, transparent, and affordable access to primary care, many people with chronic medical problems that have previously gone untreated can now be taken care of which prevents end-organ damage when chronic conditions are not controlled.

On a large scale, employers who have struggled to provide health care benefits to employees can now do so without high deductibles that limit access. Small employers that have not been able to provide health care benefits to employees due to cost can now do so by directly contracting with Direct Med Clinic.

Our model is duplicatable and sustainable because it inherently provides value. We offer a spectrum of services from primary care to urgent care to occupational medicine. We are not bound by traditional reimbursement systems so, through our virtual care and HIPAA compliant app/tools, we can expand our access way beyond a single brick and mortar clinic which allows us to touch even more lives.

We at Direct Med Clinic are excited to be transforming healthcare, improving the quality of life and healing the bottom line of many companies by restoring the direct doctor-patient relationship with Direct Primary Care.

The views expressed in this social media account are those of the practice, not individual clinicians of the Direct Med Clinic team.

messages.content:
You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B benchmark.

Definition - a company lookalike API takes a seed company and returns other
companies that resemble it. Resemblance has two halves, and they are judged
DIFFERENTLY:

  ANCHOR       - who the seed sells to, and what it fundamentally is
                 (e.g. "restaurant point-of-sale platform"). This is a HARD
                 requirement. Every lookalike must be the same kind of company
                 for the same kind of customer. No amount of feature overlap
                 substitutes for it.
  CAPABILITIES - what the seed does (e.g. payments, online ordering, payroll,
                 operations). A lookalike matches ANY non-empty subset. It does
                 not need all of them, and matching more is not required to
                 qualify - only to be a closer match.

So: a true lookalike clears the ANCHOR and shares at least one CAPABILITY.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company - the company the lookalike search started from, with its
    ANCHOR and its CAPABILITIES listed separately.
  • A CANDIDATE company - a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide in this order, and do not work backwards from a conclusion:

STEP 1 - anchor_match (the gate).
  True only if the CANDIDATE is the same kind of company as the ANCHOR, for
  the same kind of customer. Ask: would someone shopping for the SEED consider
  this company to be in the same market?
    - A different customer fails, even in the same product category
      (restaurant POS vs retail-only POS: the customer differs).
    - A different category fails, even for the same customer
      (a restaurant POS vs a restaurant-supply distributor: both sell to
      restaurants, but only one is the same kind of company).
    - Serving the category rather than competing in it fails: agencies,
      consultancies, integrators, resellers.
    - Being a customer of the category fails (an actual restaurant is not a
      lookalike of a restaurant POS platform).
    - Parent/holding companies, the seed itself, and duplicate or parody
      entries fail.
  When you cannot tell what the candidate sells, anchor_match is false.

STEP 2 - capabilities_matched (the overlap).
  List the SEED capabilities this candidate also does, copying the strings
  verbatim from the SEED's list. Include a capability when the candidate
  plausibly offers it as part of its product; leave it out when you have no
  evidence. Matching a subset is normal and expected.

STEP 3 - relevant.
  relevant = anchor_match AND capabilities_matched is non-empty.
  Nothing else changes it.

Rules that apply throughout:
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
